modinfo.author: Tommy
modinfo.description: Limits how many Palmar Pills you can carry: 5 Palmar Pill(s) and 3 Refined Palmar Pill(s) in total (vanilla 10 each), using max_stack_count plus apply_max_stack_cap (the total-carry cap the game uses for Refinement Tokens). Built for Crimson Desert 2.03.02. Field-name (V3) mod: DMM locates each field itself, so it survives game updates that move data.
modinfo.title: CD Palmar Pill Limit 5/3
